entries.source: SDK 16.4 and 26.2 PHASE.framework PHASEObject.h, byte-identical on the members; PHASE arrived in iOS 15 and the port's releases are 6.1.3 and 4.3, so there is no PHASE.framework on either. The transform is a simd_float4x4 and both transforms start at the identity written out as a literal - the SDK's matrix_identity_float4x4 is a function the 6.1.3 gate names as a weak import the release does not export - and the world transform is the object's own composed with every ancestor's
